node.description: Id of exactly one development {node} (`<{group}>/<{node}>`) whose e2eTests allow the test

envelope.description: Workspace-relative path of the SOAP envelope file (not below .git, .meta or .reports); sent unchanged. Passwords must be ${secret:…} placeholders

path.description: Endpoint path relative to e2e.soap.baseUrl, e.g. /ibis/ws/Service-01 (no scheme, host, .. or query)

workflow.description: The tested workflow: its instances in the time window are shown when no log entry names the test id

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the answer (default 60)

includeExcerpt.description: Return at most 2 KB of the response (default false; the response is always saved to a workspace file)

confirmationCode.description: The code from the preview (only where e2eTests is CONFIRM)
